record.title: China releases a progress report on its AI capacity-building plan
record.summary: China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that it released a two-year progress report on its AI Capacity-Building Inclusive Plan at the Xiong'an Global Governance Forum on October 23, 2026. In a later official briefing, a spokesperson said the report summarizes cooperation results, experience and cases, and emphasizes coordinated supply of AI models, data and talent. The full report and its project-level evidence were not available in this review. The announcement establishes a policy-report release and official framing; it does not establish project delivery, partner-country uptake or measured outcomes.
organizations: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

brief.title: China releases a progress report on its AI capacity-building plan
brief.why_it_matters: The report signals continued Chinese attention to international AI capacity-building and frames access to models, data, talent and governance as linked policy needs. If backed by sustained projects, such efforts could shape AI access and cooperation for developing countries. The source summary is official, while the full report, participating-country uptake and outcomes remain unverified.
